summary:
Where it lives and what it decides, as of the cited revision. The owning design is docs/coordination/2026-10-31-board-currency-gate.md (owning Outcome FS-GG/.github#4730, Delivery #5094); read it before changing any piece.

One rule implementation. scripts/board-currency-rules.py holds the versioned rule set (the RULESET constant) as a pure function of a snapshot; its clock is the snapshot's fetchedAt and finding IDs are rule:subject:reason with no ages. linkage_of() and override_of() are the single R1 implementation that the observer, the board-linkage check and the merge gate all import, so the three cannot disagree. Inputs are native state only (issue/PR state, PR bodies, native parent/sub-issue/blocked-by links, the Status, Work level and Track fields, and Root-login HTML-comment markers); an input that cannot be read is Unknown, never a pass. scripts/board-currency-fetch.py is the only reader and fails closed.

Three enforcement points (design section 2). (a) board-linkage (scripts/board-linkage.py, .github/workflows/board-linkage.yml) is its own light pull_request_target job, so it can later be a required context; it decides skip for non-routine PRs from the event payload before minting a token, and is advisory. (b) The merge gate in tools/routine-delivery.py (--board-gate) is the binding control because every Root merge goes through it; its default is advisory. (c) The hourly board-drift observer is the single writer of one findings issue (FS-GG/.github#4985) and merges currency findings through the drift observer's private-placeholder gate; R1 churn is body-only.

Writers. Done has exactly one writer, Project 3's built-in Item closed workflow; the merge gate never sets Done and refuses a Blocked preimage. Accepting or closing an Outcome and creating remaining Deliveries stay Root decisions. The override is a recorded PR-body marker (exact grammar in the design), evaluated before any board read, because enforce_admins leaves no bypass.

Limits: this records source at the cited revision, not deployment, installed adoption or current board state. Phase 3 (enforce, a required board-linkage context, failing the observer on new IDs) needs separate Root approval; Root also required pre-enforce controls (durable possible-send custody, enforce only from the FS-GG/.github copy) that were in review at capture time. Re-read the design, the rule-set constant and live settings before acting.
title: Board-currency gate: deterministic Project 3 rules enforced at PR, merge and observer
